title: Coverage view
description: Ephemeral derived Insight ViewModel from traust-core's coverage view (the census): for a scope (named products and teams, else every repository), what each repository had assessed by population.as_of, the repositories never assessed, and the coverage gaps their latest default-line secure-code audits report. Not a persisted artifact or SQL projection. Every serialized field is present, nullable ones included. JSON Schema checks structure and ranges, not arithmetic across fields.

kind.description: The assessment kind. Recorded kinds come from the assessment-kind registry and are served in their canonical spelling (secure_code, not secure-code); a historical stored value outside the registry is preserved as it was recorded.

population.description: What the scope had assessed by as_of, per repository and kind.

as_of.description: The point in time the population is read at: the filter's, else when the view was built.

rows.description: One row per repository and kind with at least one assessment by as_of, ordered by repository then kind.

never_assessed_repository_ids.description: Repositories in scope with no assessment of any kind by as_of, in UUID order. A repository audited clean is assessed, not absent.

latest.description: The newest assessment of this kind on the repository's default line by as_of; null when every one ran on another branch.

default_line.description: Assessments of this kind on the default line by as_of.

branches.description: Assessments of this kind on other branches by as_of (re-audits).

assessment.description: A recorded assessment: one run of one assessor over a repository ref (or an image).

image_id.description: The image examined, for a container scan; else null.

baseline_assessment_id.description: What a diff scan or verification compared against; else null.

run_order_id.description: The order that produced it; null when manual or imported.

status.description: Its outcome (for example completed or degraded; degraded ran without a usable input and is never read as clean). The vocabulary has no contracts registry yet, so any non-empty recorded value is preserved.

assessor.description: The principal that ran it (skill:<name>, tool:<name>, user:<id>), raw.

assessor_version.description: The assessor's version, raw; may be empty.

coverage.description: What the scope's latest default-line secure-code audits say they could not examine. Read from the latest audits as currently recorded, not as of population.as_of.

examined.description: Of those latest audits, how many had a report document to read.

total.description: Repositories in scope with a latest default-line secure-code audit.

gaps.description: One family per (tool, system) the audits reported they could not examine, most repositories first, then by tool and system.

tool.description: The tool or check that could not run, raw.

system.description: What it could not examine (a framework, language or system), raw.

repositories.description: Repositories whose latest audit reported this gap.

items.description: The unexamined items the audits counted, summed; null when no audit gave a count.

signals.description: How the gap was recorded, counted over the reported gaps: structured (the recording convention), steps (a deterministic pre-scan recorded as skipped) or text (a known emitter phrasing; lowest confidence). Only signals seen appear.

example_repository_ids.description: Up to eight of those repositories, from the newest audit first.
